download_file.description: Download a Sediment-backed uploaded file into the current execution workspace. Only use this tool for Sediment file IDs. Do not use it for File Service IDs or files that already have a workspace_path; read those local files directly. For sediment://file_... references, pass just the file ID. Returns a local path and byte count; use shell commands to read or search the file. Downloads do not add the file contents to context. Maximum file size is 32 MiB. If the workspace is replaced or the file is missing, download it again.
